newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator up 3c to 559c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator up 3c to 559c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose three cents to 559 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mostly higher, with the 19/20 micron indicator 1.0 percent dearer and 21/22/23m up to 1.0 percent dearer, 24m 0.5 percent dearer and 25m was unchanged.
In crossbreds, 26/27m was 0.5 percent dearer, 28m was 1.0 percent dearer, 29m was slightly cheaper and 30m 1.5 percent cheaper. 31 micron was 1.0 percent cheaper.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said Japanese and Chinese were principal buyers with support from Western Europe and Taiwan.
Of 26,727 bales offered, 7.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Wednesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 141,200 bales to be offered.
